summary: Swift scenario roster and detail envelopes decode the kit's required session, device, launch and launch-variant inventories using client-v0 wire models. Enumerating tests validate these inventory roots against the strict client schema.

schema.detail: Consumes the shared scenario inventory format without changing wire schemas or generated models.

compatibility.detail: Adds Codable roster and detail state APIs. Their inventory arrays are required, including when empty; existing network APIs are unchanged.
